storyCards.fact:
DJ Kool's "Let Me Clear My Throat" reached #30 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #30 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Let Me Clear My Throat was released in 1996.
